required_property: Navbar startup checks remain safe when URLconf completion registers additional views on an already registered ViewSet, and completed checks still validate late registrations.
description: PLAN01:107 calls _url_configuration_loaded() inside the navbar mixin checks. ViewSet.checks at src/crud_views/lib/viewset/__init__.py:286-287 iterates self._views.values() live and yields each view.checks(); _url_configuration_loaded at src/crud_views/checks.py:172-195 imports URLconf modules and can register another view on that same ViewSet. Resuming the live dictionary iterator can raise RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration. Existing check_ancestor_declarations calls its readiness barrier before taking its snapshot (checks.py:209-212); the proposed navbar path lacks an equivalent safe ordering or iteration mechanism.
fix_hint: Use a bounded readiness/iteration strategy that cannot mutate an active view iterator, and add a cold-URLconf system-check regression whose import registers another view on an already registered ViewSet. The mechanism may differ; preserve completed-registry validation and the existing opt-in/no-query boundaries.
